::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--input`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The query data to transfer the labels to. Should be a .h5mu file.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"input.h5mu"`

`--modality`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Which modality to use.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"rna"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--input_obsm_features`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The `.obsm` key of the embedding to use for the classifier's inference. If not provided, the `.X` slot will be used instead.
Make sure that embedding was obtained in the same way as the reference embedding (e.g. by the same model or preprocessing).
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"X_scvi"`
:::
::::

### Outputs

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}

::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The query data in .h5mu format with predicted labels transferred from the reference.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file` [required]{.arg-required}
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_obs_predictions`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
In which `.obs` slots to store the predicted information.
If provided, must have the same length as `--reference_obs_targets`.
If empty, will default to the `reference_obs_targets` combined with the `"_pred"` suffix.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_obs_probability`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
In which `.obs` slots to store the probability of the predictions.
If provided, must have the same length as `--reference_obs_targets`.
If empty, will default to the `reference_obs_targets` combined with the `"_probability"` suffix.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_compression`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"gzip"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"gzip"`, `"lzf"`
:::
::::
:::::

### Learning parameters

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="columnheader"}
Description
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="columnheader"}
Attributes
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--learning_rate`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Step size shrinkage used in update to prevents overfitting. Range: [0,1]. See https://xgboost.readthedocs.io/en/stable/parameter.html#parameters-for-tree-booster for the reference
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.3`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--min_split_loss`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Minimum loss reduction required to make a further partition on a leaf node of the tree. See https://xgboost.readthedocs.io/en/stable/parameter.html#parameters-for-tree-booster for the reference
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--max_depth`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Maximum depth of a tree. See https://xgboost.readthedocs.io/en/stable/parameter.html#parameters-for-tree-booster for the reference
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `6`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--min_child_weight`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Minimum sum of instance weight (hessian) needed in a child. See https://xgboost.readthedocs.io/en/stable/parameter.html#parameters-for-tree-booster for the reference
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `1`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--max_delta_step`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Maximum delta step we allow each leaf output to be. See https://xgboost.readthedocs.io/en/stable/parameter.html#parameters-for-tree-booster for the reference
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--subsample`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Subsample ratio of the training instances. See https://xgboost.readthedocs.io/en/stable/parameter.html#parameters-for-tree-booster for the reference
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `1.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--sampling_method`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The method to use to sample the training instances. See https://xgboost.readthedocs.io/en/stable/parameter.html#parameters-for-tree-booster for the reference
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"uniform"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"uniform"`, `"gradient_based"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--colsample_bytree`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Fraction of columns to be subsampled. Range (0, 1]. See https://xgboost.readthedocs.io/en/stable/parameter.html#parameters-for-tree-booster for the reference
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `1.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--colsample_bylevel`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Subsample ratio of columns for each level. Range (0, 1]. See https://xgboost.readthedocs.io/en/stable/parameter.html#parameters-for-tree-booster for the reference
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `1.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--colsample_bynode`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Subsample ratio of columns for each node (split). Range (0, 1]. See https://xgboost.readthedocs.io/en/stable/parameter.html#parameters-for-tree-booster for the reference
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `1.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--reg_lambda`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
L2 regularization term on weights. See https://xgboost.readthedocs.io/en/stable/parameter.html#parameters-for-tree-booster for the reference
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `1.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--reg_alpha`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
L1 regularization term on weights. See https://xgboost.readthedocs.io/en/stable/parameter.html#parameters-for-tree-booster for the reference
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--scale_pos_weight`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Control the balance of positive and negative weights, useful for unbalanced classes. See https://xgboost.readthedocs.io/en/stable/parameter.html#parameters-for-tree-booster for the reference
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `1.0`
:::
::::
:::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/labels_transfer/xgboost/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/labels_transfer/xgboost);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/labels_transfer/xgboost/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
